tasks.title: Extend the runner with manifest keys, clean start, invariant phase and InvariantViolation
tasks.dod: Runner executes invariants before gates, raises InvariantViolation on a returned row and clears stale report files; unit tests with a throw-away product pass.

tasks.title: Add report.py and extend the CLI: summary table, violating rows, exceptions line, reserved products, exit codes 2 and 3
tasks.dod: CLI prints summary, gate lines, violating rows, exceptions line and reserved products in the contract order and returns exit codes 0/1/2/3; unit tests pass.

tasks.title: Write the seeded data generator and commit the five synthetic input files
tasks.dod: Generator writes five byte-identical synthetic files (100-250 entries per export, Q1 2026, EUR/GBP/USD, balanced documents, daily rates) and returns the expected aligned entries.

tasks.title: Test the committed inputs: reproducibility hash, size, quarter, keys, balance, currencies, daily rates, synthetic names
tasks.dod: Tests prove byte-identical regeneration, size, first-quarter dates, balanced documents, currencies, daily rates and synthetic file names.

tasks.title: Create the DuckDB adapter files: raw load of the five inputs and the typed views
tasks.dod: DuckDB adapter loads the five inputs as they arrived and exposes raw.typed_erp_a/typed_erp_b with NULL for unreadable values; adapter tests pass.

tasks.title: Create the control views (independent raw side of the completeness gate)
tasks.dod: Control views re-read the raw tables with a separate parse; every unreadable-entry rule yields a row with NULL signed_amount; tests pass.

tasks.title: Create staging.ledger_entry: the aligned entry set (neutral SQL)
tasks.dod: staging.ledger_entry holds every readable entry of both sources in one shape with signed amount, group account, common description and deterministic entry_id; tests against the generator's expected entries pass.

tasks.title: Write the three invariant SQL checks: unique document and line, unique entry id, unambiguous mapping
tasks.dod: Three zero-row invariant SQL files stop the run on a repeated document+line, a repeated entry_id or an ambiguous mapping, naming the offenders; clean data returns zero rows; tests pass.

tasks.title: Write the completeness gate and the mapping gate
tasks.dod: 01_completeness.sql and 02_mapping.sql return zero rows on clean data and the specified rows (source system, currency, difference; document and line; local account) on the corrupted tmp copies; tests pass.

tasks.title: Write the summary query and the exceptions report query
tasks.dod: summary.sql returns entries and debit/credit totals per source system and currency present; exceptions_report.sql returns aligned entries without an exact translation row; tests pass.

tasks.title: Activate unified_gl: product.toml manifest, smoke-test update, timed CI run
tasks.dod: product.toml activates unified_gl with all manifest keys; make run succeeds end to end, the smoke test is updated and CI runs a timed make run.

tasks.title: Document the aligned entry attributes and the synthetic-data notice in the product README
tasks.dod: Product README documents all aligned-entry attributes, states the data is synthetic, and explains gates, invariants, exit codes and reports.

tasks.title: End-to-end tests: five source differences, known values, traceability, exceptions report, exit codes
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove the five source differences, equality with the generator's known values, traceability to raw records, the summary/exceptions output and exit 0 for the clean run.

tasks.title: Review F1: strict raw readability (line digits only, empty document, unreadable-line duplicates, independent format checks in control views)
tasks.dod: Fractional line, empty document, unreadable-line duplicate and lenient control-view formats are caught; tests go through the CSV load path.

tasks.title: Review F2: translate on exact untrimmed text, keep original_description as written
tasks.dod: A description with leading/trailing spaces is not translated, is listed in the exceptions report and stays as written.

tasks.title: Review F3: empty translation target counts as untranslated; invariant for a repeated translation row
tasks.dod: Empty target is listed in the exceptions report; a repeated translation row stops the run with its own message.

tasks.title: Review F4: runner contract — stale files after exit 3, unknown status, file-named errors, manifest path validation
tasks.dod: Exit 3 leaves no report files from earlier runs; unknown status, bad name/export path and failing SQL give exit 3 naming the file.

tasks.title: Review F5 a-c: AC-06 equal-attribute pair, real-manifest test, stronger weak tests
tasks.dod: Equal-attribute pair keeps distinct ids; the real product.toml stops the run on a repeated mapping/document; weak assertions are tightened.

tasks.title: Review F6: STRING instead of bare VARCHAR in neutral SQL
tasks.dod: No bare VARCHAR in neutral SQL; data-model.md corrected; a test forbids it.

tasks.title: Review F7: remove unused down scripts and 'Staged DDL' headers from products/
tasks.dod: No *.down.sql under products/; tests use the staged up files or are adjusted.

tasks.title: Review G1: export file must be a non-empty bare name; clean start removes a file or symlink in place of build/<product>
tasks.dod: Empty, '.', nested or absolute export file is a manifest error at parse time; a file or symlink at build/<product> is removed and never becomes an export root.

tasks.title: Review G6: clean start leaves build folders of reserved products alone
tasks.dod: A run does not delete build/<product> of a product whose manifest says reserved; active and unparseable products are still cleaned.

tasks.title: Review G7: manifest errors name the file; list types validated; SQL paths confined to the product folder
tasks.dod: Malformed TOML names the file; non-list sql/gates/invariants and any sql/invariants/gates/summary/export-query path outside the product folder are manifest errors (exit 3).

tasks.title: Review G3: blank translation target counts as untranslated
tasks.dod: A translation target of only spaces is untranslated in staging and listed in the exceptions report.

tasks.title: Review G4: completeness gate prints an unreadable line as written
tasks.dod: A missing entry with an unreadable line is reported with the line text from the source, not '?'.

tasks.title: Review G5: invariant messages survive an empty key
tasks.dod: Two mapping rows with an empty local account or two translation rows with an empty description print a readable offender line.

tasks.title: Review G9: invariant file numbers follow the execution order
tasks.dod: Files are numbered in the order the manifest runs them; labels and output are unchanged.

tasks.title: Review G2: ERP B and credit-side test coverage for the F1-F3 fixes
tasks.dod: Reverting any of the eight surviving mutants (ERP B empty doc_id, memo trim, credit format, ERP B date regex, empty-target description, ERP B line_text, UNKNOWN currency, currency IS NOT NULL) turns a test red.

tasks.dod: A line made of spaces prints as '?' like an empty cell (nullif(trim(..),'') for line_text in both control views, staged copies kept equal); test.
